text: An index fund tracks a market index such as the S&P 500. Index funds have low expense ratios because they are passively managed.
A Roth IRA is funded with after-tax dollars, so qualified withdrawals in retirement are tax free.
A traditional IRA contribution may be tax deductible, but withdrawals in retirement are taxed as ordinary income.
Business travel expenses such as airfare, hotels and 50% of meals are generally deductible for the self-employed.
Your credit score is affected by payment history, credit utilization, length of credit history and new credit inquiries.
Paying off a credit card balance in full each month avoids interest charges and keeps utilization low.
An emergency fund should cover three to six months of living expenses and be kept in a liquid savings account.
Dividends from stocks held in a taxable brokerage account are taxed; qualified dividends receive a lower rate.
Dollar cost averaging means investing a fixed amount at regular intervals regardless of the share price.
A mortgage refinance can lower your monthly payment if current interest rates are below your existing rate.
Bonds pay periodic coupon interest and return the principal at maturity; bond prices fall when interest rates rise.
